notes: These rows are NOT the eligibility list: Chevening is open to courses at every UK university. They are only the universities currently shown as partners, so they should not be presented as the only eligible institutions.
A partner award requires listing that university as first choice, per Chevening's guidance (search summary, not re-read in full).

The partners page names 'Birmingham Newman University', which looks like Newman University in Birmingham; the name is shortened to Newman University here. 'Trinity College, University of Oxford' is recorded as University of Oxford. One further partner shown there, a business school, is not a university and was left out.
Page read through a summary tool, so the list may be incomplete.
not_stated: A complete list of eligible courses (only the third-party course finder exists)
fetch_problems: The course finder is an interactive search and could not be read as a list.
